title: A minimum is attained among finitely many values
statement: Let $\beta$ be a linearly ordered type, let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\beta$, and let $m$ be a natural number. There is an index $k\le m$ such that the minimum obtained by starting with $f(0)$ and successively taking the minimum with $f(1),\ldots,f(m)$ equals $f(k)$.
